text:
sec-bot: Alert: policy-scan detected KMS-wrapped object with high-entropy payload in gs://partner-dumps/2026-04-10/dump.enc using key projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap :warning:

ara: @vin @chloe can you triage? Looks like server-side wrap by our ingest API at 11:22 UTC.

vin: looking. Metadata shows uploader svc-partner-uploader and encrypt_after_receive called. So plaintext likely existed upstream. First steps: suspend partner SA keys, create new key version, and block further uploads to that prefix.

chloe: agree. Short containment list:
- revoke partner SA key (vin)
- create new key-version and set primary (vin)
- schedule rewrap job to migrate ciphertext to new version (vin+chloe)
- patch ingest to use client-side envelope encryption and strip full-body logs (chloe)
- preserve flagged object and CI logs as evidence (ara/legal)

vin: revoking now. sanitized command: gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable f1e2d3c4 --iam-account=svc-partner-uploader@redwood-internal.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Applied temporary IAM deny for storage.objects.create for that SA. Uploads stopped at 11:25 UTC.

vin: creating key version and scheduling rewrap. rewrap plan: decrypt with retained old key variant, encrypt with new primary, write to gs://partner-dumps-rewrapped with metadata rewrap=true. Estimate 2h for priority shard.

chloe: quick PR to ingest service to add AES-GCM envelope client-side encryption and redact bodies from logs. will gate rollout until rewrap complete to avoid double-encrypt issues. PR up in 20m.

ara: legal: please open evidence case and notify partner ops with minimal details. preserve object copy and sha256.

legal: Evidence hold created CASE-SEC-2026-077. Notifying partner via secure channel; recommending limited disclosure.

chloe: also adding an alert for any KMS Decrypt events on partner-wrap by non-ingest principals. forwarding decrypt events to sec-audit for 90d.

ara: owners & ETA: vin (SA revoke + key-version create + temp deny) now -> 45m; vin+chloe (rewrap job + verify) kickoff in 30m, 22h; chloe (ingest PR + log redaction) PR in 20m, rollout after rewrap; ara/legal (evidence + partner notice) 1h.

vin: rewrap job started for priority set: 0/500 objects processed, will report progress.

ara: good work team. After rewrap complete we'll run a short verification and then rotate any downstream credentials that referenced archived secrets. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
